boundary: Bounded same-input RT-DBSCAN component-partition comparator gate. It compares canonical point partitions modulo component-label renaming, plus core_count, component_sizes, noise_count, and core_flags when the AuthorOfficial payload provides them. It does not claim exact author label IDs, exact paper datasets, full DBSCAN output format, or performance.

metadata.claim_boundary: App-owned comparator for pinned AuthorOfficial behavior; not a generic RTDL core semantic and not conventional DBSCAN.
